# sdmc

> sdmc (SQL DAL Maker CLI) generates the data access layer — models and DAO functions, SQL first,
> no ORM, no reflection at run time — from an XML manifest (`sdm.xml`) and the metadata of a live
> database. Targets: Go (database/sql, sqlx, gorm), Python (DB-API 2.0), C++ (Qt). Databases:
> PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server. One static binary: `go install github.com/panedrone/sdmc/cmd/sdmc@latest`.

The database must be reachable while generating: sdmc reads tables, views, foreign keys, the
result sets of your SQL and procedure parameters from it, not from DDL. Generated files are not
edited by hand: change `sdm.xml`, run `sdmc gen`; `sdmc val` exits 1 when the code is out of date.

Go, from an existing database, in the folder of `go.mod`:

```bash
sdmc init -dir sdm -dao internal/dbal -orm no_orm -db sqlite   # then <db url="sqlite:app.sqlite3"> in sdm/settings.xml
sdmc xml -orm no_orm > starting.xml                            # paste its elements into <sdm> of sdm/sdm.xml
sdmc gen
sdmc val
```

`<db url>`: `sqlite:<file>`, `postgres://host:5432/db`, `mysql://host:3306/db`,
`sqlserver://host:1433;databaseName=db;encrypt=false`; the password goes in `SDM_PWD`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/panedrone/sdmc/master/README.md): commands, options, data store, type map, Python, C++
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/panedrone/sdmc/master/plugins/sdmc/skills/sdmc/SKILL.md): the workflow step by step, with the checks before "done"
- [DTO/model XML syntax](https://sqldalmaker.sourceforge.net/dto-models.html)
- [DAO XML syntax](https://sqldalmaker.sourceforge.net/dao.html)
- [Stored procedures and functions](https://sqldalmaker.sourceforge.net/sp-udf.html)

## Examples

- [Go + Gin + SQLite, React/Vue](https://github.com/panedrone/sdm_todolist_go_react_vue_npm_sqlite3): `internal/dbal` generated by sdmc
- [Python FastAPI + SQLite](https://github.com/panedrone/sdm_todolist_fastapi_no_orm)
- [C++ Qt 6](https://github.com/panedrone/sdm_thesaurus_qt6)

## Optional

- [IDE plug-ins (Eclipse, NetBeans, JetBrains)](https://github.com/panedrone/sqldalmaker): the same `sdm.xml` and `settings.xml`
- [Releases](https://github.com/panedrone/sdmc/releases): binaries for Windows, Linux, macOS
